questions.prompt: Which command creates a new managed secret named 'api-key' with value 'token=xyz'?
questions.explanation: 'juju add-secret <name> <key>=<value>' stores the secret securely in the controller's secrets engine.

questions.prompt: How do you give application 'web' read access to secret 'api-key'?
questions.explanation: 'juju grant-secret <secret-name> <app-name>' authorizes the application to retrieve secret payload values.

questions.prompt: Which command lists all managed secrets configured in the current model?
questions.explanation: 'juju list-secrets' (or 'juju secrets') displays all secret IDs, names, and owner models.
